purpose: Full-bleed image moment between a hero and the content below: a wide photograph overlapped by a decorative pattern block, standing on a coloured band that hands over to white so the photo appears to straddle the section boundary.

variants.name: photo-on-white
variants.description: Startups Collage: white top band, photograph with descriptive alt text.

variants.name: taxi-on-gray-10
variants.description: Mobile page TaxiBand: same structure on a dark gray-10 top band, photograph with empty alt.

photoAlt.note: Descriptive on startups, empty on the mobile page.

pattern.note: Square 700 by 700 pattern block overlapped by the photo (presentation only, aria-hidden, empty alt).

bandColor.note: Colour of the top band behind the photo.

behaviour.note: A white (bg-background) slab is absolutely positioned across the bottom 64/96/128px of the band, so the photo (which carries an equal bottom margin) straddles into the following white section. No section padding of its own.

changes.change: white slab height and photo bottom margin step 64 / 96 (md) / 128 (lg)
photo bleeds off the left edge (-24px, -32px from sm) and the pattern bleeds off the right edge; from md both align to the grid
photo spans columns 1 to 11 (md), 1 to 22 (lg), 2 to 22 (xl); pattern occupies columns 6 to 12 (md), 10 to 24 (lg), from 11 (xl); pattern stacks under the photo (overlapped) below md
